text: If a man accosts you, and talks to you ever so dully or frivolously, it is worse than rudeness, it is brutality, to show him, by a manifest inattention to what he says, that you think him a fool or a blockhead, and not worth hearing.
author: Philip Stanhope, 4th Earl of Chesterfield
locator: Letter LXXXVIII, to his son, London, November 3, Old Style 1749
